concurrency_and_state: GameScr is a monolithic singleton (GameScr.instance) managing input, camera, auto-play, HUD rendering, entity loops, and actionPerform callbacks on the Unity main thread.

paint() mutates gameplay/animation/input state directly: shock_scr (5483), tMabuEff/mabuEff (5678-5696), Char.tFusion (5783-5816), tPower/dxPower/isSuperPower (5882-5913), ClanImage.addClanImage (5941), consumes GameCanvas.isPointerJustRelease and pushes info1 (5959-5963), secondVS countdown (6546-6554), flareTime (6559-6564).

update() iterates shared MyVectors (vCharInMap, Teleport.vTeleport, vMob, vNpc, vItemMap, Effect2.*, Char.vItemTime, textTime) without locking; relies on Unity main-thread execution with Controller message dispatch also touching collections (try/catch around elementAt in paint() at 5637-5642 and 5797-5802 hints at concurrent/mid-frame modification).

Client-side anti-cheat / sync touchpoints: tickMove counts 100 update ticks and sends elapsed seconds via Service.gI().checkMMove(second) (5110-5120); autoPlay() directly mutates Char.myCharz().cx/cy to mob coordinates and sends charMove() (4282-4287).
cross_module_questions: Does Server Player/Movement handler validate distance/speed on charMove() when GameScr.autoPlay() (4284-4287) teleports cx/cy directly to mob xFirst/yFirst?
Does Server openUIZone (corresponding to GameScr.openUIZone at 7262-7297) ever send zone counts or zone IDs >= 128 where signed readByte() becomes negative?

Are command IDs 11068, 11069, 11074, 11075, 12009 (assigned in openWeb, sendSms, updateKeyAlert) handled elsewhere via mScreen/GameCanvas, since GameScr.actionPerform (7393-7640) has no cases for them?
Where is GameScr.paintHPCT (8302-8331) or GameScr.paintImageBarRight (6340-6360) invoked, and does the MP bar overflow/clipping bug manifest in Vo Dai (isVS) matches?

findings.impact: Any VIP chat broadcast prefixed with '!' crashes chatVip() with ArgumentOutOfRangeException, preventing the message from being added to vChatVip.
findings.root_cause: chatVip.Substring(1, chatVip.Length) passes chatVip.Length as the length parameter starting at index 1 in C# (startIndex + length > chatVip.Length).
findings.title: Guaranteed ArgumentOutOfRangeException in chatVip() for '!' messages

findings.impact: Selecting an alert line containing '@' either extracts an incorrect player name or throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
findings.root_cause: fnick = text2.Substring(num + 1, num2) passes an end index (num2 + num) as the length argument to C# string.Substring(startIndex, length).
findings.title: Wrong Substring length argument in updateKeyAlert() causes out-of-range crash or bad nick parsing

findings.impact: Right-side VS player MP bar width overflows integer range or clips improperly whenever cMP > 0, and uses hpBarW instead of mpBarW for offset calculation.
findings.root_cause: num2 = (int)(c.cMP * mpBarW) and num4 = (int)(dMP * mpBarW) omit division by c.cMPFull (unlike cHP / c.cHPFull on lines 6342 and 6344), and lines 6354/6357 add hpBarW instead of mpBarW.
findings.title: Missing cMPFull division and wrong bar width constant in paintImageBarRight()

findings.impact: Allocates arrays, ClanImage objects, and concatenated strings every render frame inside paint(), violating Client Zero-GC invariant and increasing GC pressure/stutter.
findings.root_cause: paintSelectedSkill() allocates new string[] arrays inside the per-skill loop; paint_board_CT() allocates new int[] arrays and calls Res.split() per row; paint() constructs new ClanImage() and multiple string concatenations every frame.
findings.title: Per-frame heap allocations and string concatenation inside paint() paths

findings.impact: O(N^2) iteration over vCharInMap every frame during VS/Vo Dai maps and redundant repeated scans.
findings.root_cause: paintInfoBar() calls findCharVS1() and findCharVS2() up to 6 times per frame (plus isVS() at 6570), and findCharVS2() calls findCharVS1() inside its loop over vCharInMap.
findings.title: O(N^2) redundant player scans in paintInfoBar() via findCharVS1/findCharVS2

findings.impact: NullReferenceException in paint() if cmdMenu is null while clan message indicator, item timers, PT icon, or textTime are active.
findings.root_cause: Line 5834 guards cmdMenu != null, but lines 5878, 5917, 5934, and 5968 dereference cmdMenu.x without checking for null.
findings.title: Unchecked cmdMenu dereference in GameScr.paint()

findings.impact: Built-in autoPlay teleports client position directly to mob spawn/current coordinates and sends charMove() to server, bypassing normal pathing/movement speed if server does not validate movement deltas.
findings.root_cause: autoPlay() assigns Char.myCharz().cx = targetX and cy = targetY directly before calling Service.gI().charMove().
findings.title: autoPlay() directly teleports client coordinates to mob position

findings.impact: Left-aligned MP bar draws using delayed dMP width instead of current cMP width; paintHPCT always draws full 80px HP/MP bars regardless of actual HP/MP.
findings.root_cause: paintImageBar() passes num2 (dMP) instead of num4 (cMP) to setClip when isLeft is true (6430); paintHPCT() computes num2/num3 then hardcodes width 80 in drawRegion (8320, 8330).
findings.title: Incorrect MP bar clipping in paintImageBar() and ignored HP/MP calculations in paintHPCT()

findings.impact: State transitions, animations, countdown timers, and touch input consumption depend on render framerate and bypass update() separation.
findings.root_cause: paint() directly increments/decrements timers (shock_scr, tMabuEff, tFusion, tPower, secondVS, flareTime) and handles touch release + info1 popup for PT icon inside paint().
findings.title: Game state and input handling mutated inside GameScr.paint()

findings.impact: Potential IndexOutOfRangeException when task index exceeds mapTasks or mobIndex is out of range; PC keyHold[1] jump check in statusMe==2 has inverted Main.isPC guard and keyPressed[10] checks at 3079/3576 are unreachable after 3041.
findings.root_cause: getTaskMapId() lacks length check unlike getTaskNpcId() (7187); findMobInMap(sbyte) lacks bounds check; updateKey() clears keyPressed at 3041 before rechecking keyPressed[10] at 3079 and 3576, and checks if (Main.isPC) instead of !Main.isPC at 3344.
findings.title: Missing bounds checks and dead/inverted input branches in GameScr

key_classes.name: GameScr
key_classes.responsibility: Main in-game screen controller handling input/touch/keyboard, camera drag, auto-play, skill selection, entity update/render loops, HUD/minigame bars, zone UI parsing, and command dispatch.

module_summary: Lines 2836-8333 of GameScr.cs cover the core in-game loop of the Unity C# client: keyboard/touch/gamepad input handling (updateKey, checkDrag, checkClick, updateKeyTouchControl), combat and auto-play (doFire, doSelectSkill, doUseSkill, autoPlay, checkAuto), the main update() and paint() pipelines, HUD/VS/PhuBan/ChienTruong bars, lottery (XoSo) & VIP chat tickers, task/NPC pointers, zone list decoding (openUIZone), and command routing (actionPerform). Heavy God-class coupling mixes rendering with state/input mutation and exhibits several paint-time allocations, substring indexing bugs, and HUD math errors.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Reads zoneCount (byte); per zone: zoneId (byte), pts (byte), numPlayer (byte), maxPlayer (byte), hasRank (byte); if hasRank==1: rankName1 (UTF), rank1 (int), rankName2 (UTF), rank2 (int).
Sends single char input for anti-bot mob captcha.
Syncs current player position/direction to server (also invoked immediately after teleporting cx/cy in autoPlay).
Uses bag item (type 0, where 1, index i) for capsule 193/194 or (-1,-1,-1,-1) for dragon ball pickup action.
Sends elapsed wall-clock seconds per 100 client update ticks for speed-hack detection.

Dispatches requestPean, pickItem, chat, chatPlayer, getFlag, petStatus, friend, giaodich, playerMenu actions, player_vs_player, returnTownFromDead, wakeUpFromDead, confirmMenu, requestChangeZone, getClan, clanInvite.
